headline: Itaú Unibanco Reports R$ 12.6 Billion Net Income in Third Quarter
summary: Itaú Unibanco posted a recurrent net income of R$ 12.6 billion for the third quarter of 2026, marking a 6.7% year-over-year increase but coming in slightly below market consensus.
why: Itaú Unibanco is Latin America's largest private bank, serving as a key indicator of credit quality and banking sector profitability in the region.

impacts.name: Itaú Unibanco
impacts.why: The bank reported quarterly earnings and ROE figures slightly below expectations.
